profile.headline: Software Developer | Classical Guitar Teacher | Guitarist
profile.summary:
Classical guitarist, composer, music educator, software developer specializing in frontend web development (React, Typescript, Javascript, Node.js, Express, HTML, CSS, Centering divs).

As a guitarist, composer, music editor, I've worked on projects ranging from independent to AAA. As a music educator, my classical guitar students have gone on to win over $500,000 in music scholarships and competition prizes. 

https://www.imdb.com/name/nm5628349/

positions.title: Classical Guitar Teacher
positions.description: Founded and run a guitar school in Santa Monica. 30+ classical guitarists, award winning (GFA, Diamond Bar, RCM, Pacific Guitar Festival, Classics Alive).
